panels.description: Traffic rate of the interfaces in use, as measured by SR Linux. The Node selector narrows it from the whole fabric (All) to single switches.
panels.title: Interface throughput

options.panelConfig:
---
anchors:
  thresholds-operstate: &thresholds-operstate
    - { color: "red", level: 0 }
    - { color: "green", level: 1 }
  thresholds-traffic: &thresholds-traffic
    - { color: "gray", level: 0 }
    - { color: "green", level: 10000 }
    - { color: "yellow", level: 500000 }
    - { color: "orange", level: 2000000 }
    - { color: "red", level: 5000000 }
  thresholds-rate-label: &thresholds-rate-label
    - { color: "white", level: 0 }
  label-config: &label-config
    separator: "replace"
    units: "bps"
    decimalPoints: 1
    valueMappings:
      - { valueMax: 10000, text: "\u200B" }
cellIdPreamble: "cell-"
tagConfig:
  legend: ["hide-rates"]
  lowlightAlphaFactor: 0
  highlightRgbFactor: 1
cells:
  "leaf1:e1-1":
    dataRef: "oper-state:leaf1:e1-1"
    fillColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-operstate
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "spine:e1-1":
    dataRef: "oper-state:spine:e1-1"
    fillColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-operstate
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "link_id:leaf1:e1-1:spine:e1-1":
    dataRef: "leaf1:e1-1:out"
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "link_id:leaf1:e1-1:spine:e1-1:label":
    dataRef: "leaf1:e1-1:out"
    label: *label-config
    labelColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-rate-label
  "link_id:spine:e1-1:leaf1:e1-1":
    dataRef: "spine:e1-1:out"
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "link_id:spine:e1-1:leaf1:e1-1:label":
    dataRef: "spine:e1-1:out"
    label: *label-config
    labelColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-rate-label
  "leaf2:e1-2":
    dataRef: "oper-state:leaf2:e1-2"
    fillColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-operstate
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "spine:e1-2":
    dataRef: "oper-state:spine:e1-2"
    fillColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-operstate
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "link_id:leaf2:e1-2:spine:e1-2":
    dataRef: "leaf2:e1-2:out"
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "link_id:leaf2:e1-2:spine:e1-2:label":
    dataRef: "leaf2:e1-2:out"
    label: *label-config
    labelColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-rate-label
  "link_id:spine:e1-2:leaf2:e1-2":
    dataRef: "spine:e1-2:out"
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "link_id:spine:e1-2:leaf2:e1-2:label":
    dataRef: "spine:e1-2:out"
    label: *label-config
    labelColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-rate-label
  "leaf1:e1-5":
    dataRef: "oper-state:leaf1:e1-5"
    fillColor:

    tags: ["hide-rates"]
  "leaf2:e1-5":

    fillColor:

    tags: ["hide-rates"]

    strokeColor:

panels.title: Network topology
panels.description: Live view of the lab topology. Link halves are coloured by the traffic rate leaving that end of the link, interface bubbles by oper-state.
Active routes that were installed with gRIBI, per switch.
panels.title: gRIBI routes

panels.description: leaf1 reaches 2.2.2.2 through the spine, until a gRIBI route sends the traffic over the direct link to leaf2.
panels.title: Traffic leaving leaf1

panels.description: Routes of the default network instance. A route injected with gRIBI shows up with the type gribi and takes over from the BGP route, which has a higher preference value.
panels.title: IPv4 route table

panels.description: Accepted gRPC calls per RPC since the switch booted, across all gRPC servers. Every gnmic, gnoic or gnsic command you run against this switch adds to its RPC.
panels.title: gRPC calls

panels.description: Rejected calls: calls the switch turned down, such as failed logins and calls the user may not make. Policy denials: calls denied by the gNSI Authz policy.
panels.title: gRPC rejects

panels.description: Name of the installed gNSI Authz policy. It changes with a gNSI Authz Rotate.
panels.title: Authz policy

panels.description: TLS profile used by the secure gRPC server and when its certificate expires. A gNSI Certz Rotate followed by a profile change shows up here.
panels.title: gRPC certificate

panels.description: Port MTU of the interfaces in use.
panels.title: Interface MTU

panels.description: BGP statistics of the default network instance. Empty until BGP is configured.
panels.title: BGP

panels.description: Active routes of the default network instance and MAC addresses across all MAC-VRFs.
panels.title: Routes and MACs
